IS/ISO/TS 17033 : 2019 Ethical Claims and Supporting Information-Principles and Requirements
ICS 03.120.20
MSD 14
New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard which is identical with ISO/TS 17033 : 2019 ‘Ethical claims and supporting information — Principles and requirements’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation(s) of the CASCO — National Mirror Committee and approval of the Management and Systems Division Council.The text of ISO technical specification 17033 : 2019, was finalized for publication as an Indian Standard by CASCO, National Mirror Committee of Management and Systems Division Council after the national consensus was reached through the process of Wide Circulation. Certain terminologies and conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particular drawn to the following:a) Wherever the words ‘Technical Specification’ appear referring to this document, they should be read as ‘Indian Standard’.b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker, while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker.
